source.attribution: BridgeData V2, Homer Walke et al., RAIL Berkeley

selection_rule: Filter original CSV annotations for sink, dishware, pot/pan, sponge/brush, cleaning, kitchen operations, cloth/laundry and other actions; keep fixed CSV line numbers chosen to cover these groups and explicit hard-negative pairs; no random sampling and no archive download. Select first, floor(last/2), last frames from images0.

dishwashing_assessment.finding: No direct robot dishwashing positive was found in the selected set or in the full-CSV wash/rinse/clean keyword scan. Wiping a pot with a sponge is only a wiping action; placing pots or utensils in a dry toy sink is only placement. Neither is relabeled as washing dishes.
dishwashing_assessment.scope_limit: The keyword scan does not prove that every one of the complete BridgeData trajectories lacks dishwashing; it is sufficient to exclude an unsupported dishwashing positive from this quality set.
dishwashing_assessment.aggregate_metric_rule: The robot-washes-dishes query is diagnostic-only with zero positives and is excluded from Top-k and MRR aggregates.
